Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

greta.gp (development version)

greta.gp 0.2.3

CRAN release: 2026-07-21

  • Resubmission to CRAN. greta.gp was archived in September 2025 as a consequence of its dependency, greta, being archived. greta returned to CRAN as version 0.6.0, and this release restores greta.gp.
  • Now depends on greta version 0.6.0 or above.
  • Fixed a grammatical error in the package Description.
  • Fixed the r-universe installation instructions in the README, which referred to the wrong package.

greta.gp 0.2.2

CRAN release: 2024-11-13

  • Add “rlang” to package imports.
  • update internals to use cli_abort
  • depend on greta version 0.5.0 and R version 0.4.1

greta.gp 0.2.1

CRAN release: 2024-01-29

  • Use sentinel “_PACKAGE”

greta.gp 0.2.0

CRAN release: 2022-09-06

  • Added a NEWS.md file to track changes to the package.
